articles.title: Marcus Urey Receives Heroic Recognition from Rochdale Borough Council
articles.excerpt: Marcus Urey has been awarded 'heroic recognition' by Rochdale Borough Council for his bravery in saving a person from a canal and ensuring they received support.
articles.content_html:
A man has been granted 'heroic recognition' by Rochdale Borough Council for his bravery after saving a person from a canal. Marcus Urey was acknowledged for his actions, which included ensuring that the person received the necessary support following the incident.

The council praised Urey for his 'bravery and compassion' during the rescue. His quick response and willingness to help have been highlighted as exemplary, showcasing the importance of community spirit.

The recognition comes as part of the council's initiative to celebrate acts of courage within the community. Urey's actions have drawn attention to the significance of looking out for one another in times of need.

Details about the specific circumstances of the rescue have not been disclosed, but the council's commendation reflects the positive impact of Urey's intervention and the values of compassion and bravery that the council seeks to promote.

articles.title: Rochdale Town Centre Showcases Britain in Bloom Entry
articles.excerpt: Britain in Bloom judges are visiting Rochdale today to assess the town centre as part of the national competition. The local group, Rochdale in Bloom, is hoping for success in this year's event.
articles.content_html:
Britain in Bloom judges are visiting Rochdale today to assess the town centre as part of the national competition. The assessment is a key moment for the local group, Rochdale in Bloom, which has worked throughout the year to enhance the area's floral displays and overall appearance.

The judges will evaluate various aspects of the town centre, including the quality of the planting, community involvement, and environmental sustainability. This competition aims to encourage communities to improve their local environment and promote pride in their area.

Rochdale in Bloom has been actively preparing for this visit, with volunteers contributing to the upkeep of gardens and public spaces. The group hopes that their efforts will be recognised by the judges and lead to a positive outcome in the competition.

The results of the competition will be announced later this year, and the local group is optimistic about their chances. The visit from the judges is seen as an opportunity to showcase the hard work and dedication of the community in maintaining a vibrant town centre.

articles.title: Rochdale Solar PV Carport Canopy Project Announced
articles.excerpt: A solar PV carport canopy project has been announced for Rochdale, aiming to enhance renewable energy use in the area.
articles.content_html:
A solar photovoltaic (PV) carport canopy project has been announced for Rochdale, according to PolySolar UK. The initiative aims to provide renewable energy solutions while utilising existing car park spaces.

The project will involve the installation of solar panels on canopies over parking areas, generating clean energy for local use. This development is part of a broader effort to increase sustainability in the region.

Details regarding the exact locations and timelines for the installation have yet to be released. However, the project is expected to contribute positively to the local energy landscape.

Further information will be made available as the project progresses.

articles.title: Rochdale Weather Forecast: Sunny Intervals Expected This Week
articles.excerpt: The Met Office has issued a weather forecast for Rochdale, predicting a mix of sunny intervals and rain over the coming days, with temperatures ranging from 18°C to 22°C.
articles.content_html:
The Met Office has released the latest weather forecast for Rochdale, indicating a mix of conditions in the coming days. Today, temperatures are expected to reach a maximum of 21°C, with cloudy skies and a 30% chance of rain later in the evening.

On Wednesday, the forecast predicts sunny intervals with a high of 21°C and a similar chance of rain at 30% around 10pm. Thursday will see slightly cooler temperatures of 19°C, again with sunny intervals and a 30% chance of rain in the morning.

Friday is expected to remain mild at 18°C, with sunny intervals and a 30% chance of rain at 9am. The weekend will bring slightly warmer temperatures, with Sunday reaching up to 22°C, although rain is likely in the evening.

Residents should prepare for moderate pollen levels throughout the week, particularly on sunny days. Wind gusts are expected to vary, reaching up to 28mph on Thursday.

articles.title: Phil Eckersley Promises Support for Greater Manchester Boroughs Ahead of Mayoral Election
articles.excerpt: Conservative mayoral candidate Phil Eckersley has pledged to enhance support for Greater Manchester's boroughs, addressing crime and housing issues in an interview.
articles.content_html:
Phil Eckersley, the Conservative candidate for Mayor of Greater Manchester, has pledged to provide more support to the boroughs of the region in an interview with the source. He expressed concern that too much focus has been placed on the city centre, leaving towns on the outskirts, including Rochdale, feeling neglected.

Eckersley highlighted the rise in crime in the boroughs, stating that residents are 'too scared to walk home after 8pm' due to fears of anti-social behaviour. He attributed part of this issue to the Greater Manchester Police, claiming they have not effectively addressed these concerns. He called for increased stop and searches and a greater police presence across the region, rather than just in the city centre.

In addition to crime, Eckersley aims to build more affordable homes throughout Greater Manchester, focusing on developing brownfield sites to protect green spaces. He also promised to support local businesses, asserting that he would be the 'most pro-business mayor Greater Manchester has ever had.'

Eckersley's policies align closely with those of Labour candidate Bev Craig, particularly regarding affordable housing and support for boroughs outside the city centre. However, he believes Labour has failed to deliver for the region during their time in control of the mayoralty since 2015. The Greater Manchester Mayoral by-election is scheduled for Thursday, 30th July.
